interface.name: ferese_material_manager_v1
interface.description: Clients can request the desktop's standard modal material behind their own surface. The compositor chooses the color, opacity, radius and blur. This grants no access to backdrop pixels or privileged shell roles. Clients should leave their surface background transparent after attachment.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: surface already has material or effects

interface.name: ferese_surface_material_v1
interface.description: The material changes only rendering, never focus, input, geometry or stacking. Destroying this object restores the surface's ordinary rendering.
